title: Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online

reading.body:
An AI image generation system was used to create non-consensual sexually explicit images of a real person without her knowledge or consent. The person using the system obtained source photographs from the victim's private social media account and used AI tools to generate morphed, obscene content. The deployment failure was complete absence of access controls, consent verification, or output screening.

The generated images were then distributed across multiple platforms through fake accounts, which represents a second failure: the social media platforms did not detect or prevent the spread of non-consensual intimate imagery. The person responsible reportedly used technical methods to obscure his identity across multiple services and accounts.

Whether the AI system itself had safety measures to detect this misuse is not established from the reporting.

reports.title: Delhi: Man held for circulating obscene AI-generated photos of college acquaintance
Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online

summary:
A 22-year-old man named Keshav Bansal was arrested in Delhi for creating and spreading obscene artificial intelligence-generated images of a college acquaintance. Bansal, a BTech graduate in Electronics and Communication Engineering, obtained photographs from the woman's private social media account and used AI technology to create morphed, sexually explicit content. He then distributed these images through multiple fake accounts on Instagram, Discord, and Facebook while using various Gmail addresses to hide his identity.

The victim, also 22 years old, reported the harassment to the Cyber Police Station in North Delhi after receiving messages from anonymous accounts informing her that her manipulated photographs and videos were being shared on Discord servers. Police launched an investigation, analyzing digital footprints and technical evidence to trace the fake profiles back to Bansal. During questioning, he revealed that he knew the woman from college and harbored personal resentment toward her due to previous conflicts. Police recovered a mobile phone, two SIM cards, and other digital evidence during the investigation, which is still ongoing.
title_en: Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online
